profile.name: 串口实验I/O控制器
profile.description: 这是一类通过串口通信的通用实验室I/O控制器，可提供数字输出、模拟输出、脉冲/闪烁控制、舵机控制，以及模拟量和温度读取功能。它常用于显微镜和实验装置中的外设联动与自动化控制，例如驱动快门、激光相关部件、振动机构或读取传感器信号。
profile.description_en: This is a general-purpose laboratory I/O controller that communicates over a serial port. It provides digital outputs, analog outputs, flash/pulse-style control, servo control, and analog and temperature readback. It is commonly used for peripheral coordination and automation in microscopes and other lab setups, such as driving shutters, laser-related components, shaking mechanisms, or reading sensor signals.

registry.description: Implementation of IOSlave without context managers on the serial commands
